electrical_path.warning: Apparent source-to-FC path includes measurement offsets, load-dependent leads/connectors, supply and FC filtering. Not a four-wire resistance measurement or battery sag model.

vibration.method: Welch 2048 samples, longest contiguous late-plateau segment; gyro XYZ summed PSD; high-resolution scale corrected; no interpolation across missing frames.
vibration.scope: FC mounted on the bench/rig; not a free-flight structural vibration survey.

sequence_validation.method: No F-sequence fitting. Use recorded FC motor command and filtered delivered bus voltage; compare inside static convex hull after 0.3s continuous rotation. RPM models trained on E; force/torque models include measurement path.
sequence_validation.clock_limit: Affine edge registration cannot separate fixed host-to-FC latency. RPM timing uses same FC clock.
